name: ImageCHD (Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, MICCAI 2020) - congenital heart disease cardiac CTA
format: NIfTI (.nii.gz) inside a 13-part split zip (ImageCHD_dataset.z01..z12 + ImageCHD_dataset.change2zip, which is the final .zip part renamed)
labels: 7 whole-heart classes (LV, RV, LA, RA, myocardium, aorta, pulmonary artery) + some stray labels (airway etc.); per-patient CHD diagnosis spreadsheet (16 CHD types)
steps_to_access: Anonymous: curl -L https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/imagechd/<file> worked without login on 2026-10-12 (redirects to a signed GCS URL). Note: small parts come back wrapped in a Kaggle zip (unzip/funzip first). Proper route: free Kaggle account + API token, then `kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/imagechd`; unzip; rename ImageCHD_dataset.change2zip -> ImageCHD_dataset.zip; `7z x ImageCHD_dataset.zip` (or `zip -s 0 ImageCHD_dataset.zip --out full.zip && unzip full.zip`).
provenance/duplicates: Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital (same hospital as ImageCAS), Siemens SOMATOM Definition Flash, acquisitions 2017-2018, mostly children (birth years 2010-2017 seen) plus some adults. CHD68 (MICCAI 2019) is very likely a subset (same ID scheme 1001..., same 7 labels). Patient overlap with ImageCAS (adults with suspected CAD, 2012-2018) unlikely but not provable. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Kaggle API file list read (13 parts, 8.94 GB). Downloaded last part (129 MB), read the zip central directory: 223 entries = 110 ct_XXXX_image.nii.gz + 110 labels + 2 xlsx. Extracted both xlsx (110 rows: birth date, acquisition date, sex, pixel spacing 0.24-0.42 mm, z 0.75 mm, scanner = SOMATOM Definition Flash). Streamed first 73 MB of part z01 and extracted ct_1001_image.nii.gz + label: 512x512x221 int16, stored value = HU+1024 (0..4095); blood-pool labels median ~1550-1670 => ~530-650 HU, myocardium ~1196 => ~170 HU, i.e. contrast-enhanced cardiac CT. Files deleted.
notes: NIfTI header spacing is a placeholder (1x1x1 mm) - real spacing is only in imagechd_dataset_image_info.xlsx; subtract 1024 to get HU. The xlsx carries PatientBirthDate and AcquisitionDate (quasi-identifiers) - strip before redistributing annotations. Paediatric CHD hearts: coronaries are small and anatomy abnormal; good for robustness, weaker for adult 14-class coronary labelling. NC licence.

name: ImageALCAPA (Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, BIBM 2022) - anomalous left coronary artery from pulmonary artery, cardiac CTA
labels: 7 classes: Myo, LV, RV, PA, Ao, LCA, RCA (left and right coronary artery labelled)
steps_to_access: As ImageCHD: kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/imagealcapa (or anonymous curl of each part via https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/imagealcapa/<file>); rename .change2zip -> .zip; 7z x.
provenance/duplicates: GDPH, SOMATOM Definition Flash, June 2016 - Aug 2021, pre-operative ALCAPA (mostly paediatric). Archive includes macOS '._' junk files. Possible patient overlap with ImageCHD (same hospital/years, ALCAPA is a CHD) - not checkable. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Kaggle file list read; downloaded the final part (424 MB), listed central directory: 30 images + 30 labels (1..30). Extracted volumes whose data sit in the last part: 7_image is 512x512x247 int16, HU+1024 encoding, secondary histogram peak ~400 HU (contrast blood). Files deleted.
notes: Only public CT set I found with LCA/RCA labels besides ImageCAS/ASOCA, but coronary anatomy is pathological (LCA arises from the PA). Same header caveats as ImageCHD (1 mm placeholder spacing, +1024 offset).

name: HOCMvalvesSeg (GDPH, MIDL 2024) - hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy cardiac CT
format: Uncompressed NIfTI (.nii) per case, individually downloadable (Kaggle zip 1.15 GB)
labels: AV, MV, AO, LA, LV, myocardium, excised myocardium
steps_to_access: TESTED: curl -L -o 12_image.nii https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg/12_image.nii (HTTP 200, 111 MB, no login). Bulk: kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/hocmvalvesseg.
provenance/duplicates: GDPH, Siemens SOMATOM Definition Flash, adults 38-76 y. Same hospital and scanner type as ImageCAS (adults) - small possibility that some patients also appear in ImageCAS; unverifiable (no IDs/dates). Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Downloaded 12_image.nii + 12_label.nii (111 MB each): 512x512x425, but dtype uint8 (0-255), header spacing 1x1x1 placeholder. Label medians: LA/LV/AO blood ~210-220 vs myocardium 82 => contrast-enhanced, but intensities are 8-bit windowed, not HU. Files deleted.
notes: Lossy: 8-bit windowed images with no HU and no true spacing (README says ~0.25x0.25x0.5 mm). Usable for annotation viewing only with a fixed window; weaker for HU-dependent work. Not described as ECG-gated CCTA but HOCM surgical-planning CT at GDPH is cardiac-gated CTA (unverified).

name: CHD68 whole-heart & great vessel segmentation (GDPH, MICCAI 2019)
provenance/duplicates: LIKELY DUPLICATE: subset of ImageCHD (same hospital, same case-ID scheme 1001,1002,1004,1007... in the GitHub README diagnosis table, same 7 labels). Do not count separately.
verified: Kaggle file list read (8 parts). README read at github.com/XiaoweiXu/Whole-heart-and-great-vessel-segmentation-of-chd_segmentation. Images not opened.
notes: Count 0 new scans if ImageCHD is taken.

name: ImageTAAD (GDPH, Medical Image Analysis 2025) - type-A aortic dissection CTA

n_scans.unit: patients (100 train + 20 test, nnU-Net Task068 layout)

format: NIfTI (.nii.gz) in nnU-Net folder layout, inside a 7-part split zip (z01..z06 of 4.29 GB each + .change2zip); also code + model weights
labels: 35 classes (aortic segments, true/false lumen, tear, branch arteries, some abdominal organs) - no coronary labels
steps_to_access: kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/imagetaad (~27 GB); rename imageTAAD.change2zip -> .zip; 7z x. Large parts are served raw (not Kaggle-wrapped) and accept HTTP Range.
provenance/duplicates: GDPH. Possible patient overlap with ImageTBAD is impossible (different disease) but scanner/hospital shared with ImageCAS. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Streamed the start of imageTAAD.z01 and extracted dataset.json + TAAD_101_0000.nii.gz (210 MB): 512x512x972 (neck-to-femoral), HU+1024 encoding, contrast lumen shoulder ~250-350 HU. Files deleted.
notes: Whole-aorta CTA; heart and coronary ostia in field of view, gating not documented. TAAD CTAs are often ECG-gated at the root, which would raise value - check DICOM-free NIfTI visually before using.

name: ImageTBAD (GDPH, Frontiers in Physiology 2021) - type-B aortic dissection CTA
labels: True lumen, false lumen, false-lumen thrombus
steps_to_access: kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/imagetbad; rename .change2zip -> .zip; 7z x.
provenance/duplicates: GDPH, Jan 2013 - Apr 2019, GE/Siemens/Philips scanners. Derivatives on Kaggle (e.g. zaryabahmadkhan/2d-slicing-of-imagetbad-dataset, aymanabaid/diffusiontbad) are NOT new scans. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Kaggle file list and description read; images not opened.
notes: Non-gated aortic CTA, coronaries only partly visible. Low priority.

name: Pulmonary arteries & veins segmentation for lung-cancer surgery (GDPH) - Kaggle 'mytest'
format: Uncompressed NIfTI (.nii) per case (Kaggle zip 2.2 GB)
labels: Pulmonary arteries and veins (usually one lung only)
steps_to_access: kaggle datasets download -d xiaoweixumedicalai/mytest (per-file anonymous URLs also work).
provenance/duplicates: GDPH, SOMATOM Definition Flash, lung-cancer surgery patients.
verified: Kaggle file list read (212 files). Images not opened; contrast phase not verified.
notes: Chest CT for pulmonary-vessel planning; probably contrast-enhanced, not gated. Lowest priority.

name: ICADD - Indian Coronary Artery Disease Dataset (JNCASR + Sri Jayadeva Institute, Bengaluru)
labels: None (unannotated); invasive FFR/RFR for 29+ patients, echo and haematology reports, demographics
license: Not stated for data; preprint CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
steps_to_access: Email corresponding author Santosh Ansumali (JNCASR, [contact removed]). Preprint: 'available from the corresponding author on request. It may require a sub-contract for data access or service fee.' Project lead must write; expect weeks and possibly a fee/contract.
provenance/duplicates: Independent new cohort (South India, Apr 2018 - Dec 2021). Philips Brilliance 64, retrospective ECG gating, 0.4x0.4 mm pixels, 0.5 mm spacing, NTG + beta-blocker.
verified: Read primary preprint full text (medRxiv JATS XML): cohort, scanner, protocol, data-availability statement. No public download exists.
notes: Genuine ECG-gated CCTA with invasive FFR - high value per scan, small and request-only. Not on any repository.

name: Figshare 'cardiac ct data_15sets' (Xuesong Lu et al., Chinese group) - 4D dual-source cardiac CT

n_scans.unit: patients (one registered time-phase volume per archive; description says 21 phases were acquired)

format: RAR archives each containing MetaImage (.mhd/.raw float32)
steps_to_access: TESTED: curl -L -o 8.rar https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/3322322 (72 MB, HTTP 200); bsdtar -xf 8.rar (or unrar). File list via https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/1379059.
provenance/duplicates: Uploaded 2015 by Xuesong Lu; matches Lu et al. 2017 BioMed Eng OnLine (PMC5370472) and Zha et al. 2015 PLOS ONE (15 patients, Siemens Somatom Definition DSCT). Hospital/country of acquisition not verified (authors are at a Chinese university). Independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Downloaded 8.rar: one volume 'pat8reg-tp0' 512x512x117, spacing 0.3125x0.3125x1 mm, float32 intensities linearly normalised (-2.3..6.7; not HU). Histogram has a distinct peak at ~1.2 above the soft-tissue peak (~0.35), consistent with contrast-filled cardiac chambers (~450 HU if linear). Files deleted.
notes: Cropped, normalised, 1 mm slices, one phase per patient in the archives - modest quality for coronary work, but CC BY (most permissive in this list). Coronary visibility depends on the crop; check visually.

name: MM-WHS 2017 CT part (Zhuang lab, Fudan University; data from two Shanghai hospitals)

n_scans.unit: patients (20 labelled train + 40 test, images released)

labels: 7 whole-heart classes on the 20 training CTs
license: Custom data access agreement (no redistribution to third parties)
steps_to_access: Project lead signs res/Data_Access_Agreement_for_Participants.pdf (https://zmiclab.github.io/zxh/0/mmwhs/res/Data_Access_Agreement_for_Participants.pdf), emails it to the organisers ([contact removed]), then downloads from the FDU server or MEGA link on the data page. Site says maintenance has ended; points to CARE.
provenance/duplicates: Shanghai, 'routine cardiac CT angiography', ~0.78 mm in-plane, 1.6 mm slices (data page). Probably included in CARE WHS++ CT. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Read primary data page and home page. Not downloaded (DUA).
notes: Agreement forbids sharing data with third parties - check whether shared derived labels are allowed.

name: CARE 2024 WHS++ track - CT part (Zhuang lab, Fudan)

n_scans.unit: CT volumes (40 train + 30 val released; 34 test withheld)

steps_to_access: Register on the CARE 2024 site ('Join the challenge', https://www.zmic.org.cn/care_2024/join/) to get data access; organisers assign an account. Wait: days to weeks; may be closed after the challenge window.
provenance/duplicates: Centre A Philips 64-slice, Centre B Siemens dual-source / GE; 'standard coronary CT angiography protocols'. Probably a superset of MM-WHS CT (likely overlap ~60) - unverified. Also listed by Challenges agent.
verified: Read primary track page (data split, scanners, protocol). Not downloaded.
notes: Real CCTA protocol (could be T1) but only ~70 released images and probably overlapping MM-WHS.

name: Korean AI-Hub (aihub.or.kr) - open catalogue search
verified: Queried the AI-Hub catalogue on 2026-10-12 for 심장 (15 hits), 관상동맥 (2 hits), 심혈관 (6), 혈관 (26): only ECG, echocardiography, carotid CT/MRI (JPG 2D) and clinical data - no cardiac or coronary CT. All health sets are '안심존' (safe-zone, application) anyway.

name: Chinese national/platform repositories checked with no CCTA image release found (ScienceDB, Tianchi, Baidu AI Studio, ModelScope, OpenDataLab/OpenXLab, Gitee, HyperAI, CNGBdb)
provenance/duplicates: Where cardiac items exist on these platforms they are mirrors of ImageCAS / MM-WHS / ASOCA / Sunnybrook (e.g. HyperAI torrents) - duplicates.
verified: ScienceDB: DataCite query of prefix 10.57760 for coronary/cardiac and CTA/angiography titles - only clinical tables, a coronary-microvascular multimodal set (clinical), no CCTA images. Tianchi/AI Studio/Gitee/ModelScope: web searches (Chinese and English terms incl. 冠状动脉CT血管造影 数据集, 冠脉CTA 数据集, 冠状动脉分割 数据集, 心脏CT 数据集, 冠脉 斑块 数据集) found no CCTA image release; ModelScope and OpenXLab search APIs need login / returned errors, so those two are NOT exhaustively verified.
notes: Chinese CCTA papers (e.g. 10,101-exam Radiology:AI 2026 study; 16,300-patient PS-CTA-Plaque-Atlas, github.com/MEI243/PS-CTA-Plaque-Atlas; PDSCA 100 cases PUMCH; GeoCAD 70) are in-house - no images released. PS-CTA-Plaque-Atlas ships derived CSV/atlas files only.
